Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

A spark, a drop or a pebble circles your palm. You give it a name, and it unfolds into a restless little shape.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One visible unoccupied placement within 3 squares that fits the chosen form's entire footprint.
Type
Magic / Summoning

Choose one Elemental entry from the summon selection with a minimum tier of 1 or lower. Call one instance using its summon profile. Choose the form anew each casting. It remains for one scene.
